eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 2:13 PM on AUG 23, 2023 Effective until 2:13 PM AUG 24, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The voluntary evacuation for the residents of the Town of Merryville, residents along Hwy 110W between Merryville and Singer and residence on Neale Oilfield Rd East of Merryville has been lifted at this time. It has been deemed for you to return to your residences. We are keeping a voluntary evacuation order in effect for residents from the intersection of Hwy 27 and Hwy 110W in Singer, north to Otto Franklin Rd to include the community in and around Dude Slaydon Loop and Grantham Road. Voluntary evacuation order. Please follow instructions in CAP alert
